g.text: GDHUB-117 — day 1: the goal is read after payment, the tasks are set and checked

text.tspan: Purchase: the author writes only the goal,
picks the curator, pays
(no AI call before payment — pro or AI)
Pro: the checkpoint starts on the day of call 1;
the goal and tasks open for that day and 12 hours more
Call 1 inside the window:
the author adjusts the goal and tasks on the call or after it
The plan is approved: the goal and tasks lock
(tasks open again after the sprint 2 review, as today)

g.text: The checkpoint starts; the goal and tasks open

text.tspan: Call 1 — the goal read: does the goal fit 28 days and the team?
and 3–5 suggested tasks, each with why
The first letter: hello, write 1–5 tasks that will show the goal is reached;
under the goal: it fits, or widen / narrow it;
the suggestions with Add
/workflow/cp{N}/review/1
the author adds suggestions or writes tasks, may change the goal
24 hours and no tasks yet:
a reminder; the window stays open

g.text: Save and send to the curator? (confirm)

text.tspan: Call 2 — the check: advice under the goal and under each task
(keep / shorten / reword / cut, and why)

g.text: The author is told: the curator checked your plan

text.tspan: The author re-reads, adjusts the goal and tasks if needed
(no second check)
12 hours after the check, not approved:
the plan approves itself as it stands
AI: the closing letter (fixed text):
well done with the tasks — now you know what to do; looking forward to your devlogs

g.text: No model call before payment: nobody who does not buy costs anything
No tasks, no close: the checkpoint never runs on an empty plan
One check per checkpoint start: edits after it are the author's, approved as they stand
The first letter is written once, however many times the payment webhook fires
